segment.source: Renders a heading and an explanatory paragraph on one side of the band and the list of destinations on the other, swappable left to right. Use it for: a section landing page that has to say what the section is before listing it, an overview aimed at one audience, a hub with a mission line above its links. Prefer 'Page Card Menu' when the intro belongs centred above the grid, and 'Featured Entry Menu' when one destination should lead the rest.
